title: Best robot lawn mower deal: Save 34% on the EcoVacs Goat 01000
excerpt: Spend 15 minutes setting it up, and that'll be the end of your work during mowing season.
content_html:
SAVE $335.99: The EcoVacs Goat 01000 robot lawn mower is on sale at Amazon for $664, down from the normal price of $999.99. That's a 34% discount that matches the lowest we've spotted at Amazon.

Credit: zEcoVacs

$664 at Amazon
$999.99 Save $335.99

The world has become a better place lately if you don't enjoy mowing the lawn. In the same way we have robot vacuums to clean up messes inside, a robot lawn mower is at-the-ready to keep the grass well manicured. If you're interested but have been turned off by the prices that often go over four figures, check out this deal.

As of Aug. 4, the EcoVacs Goat 01000 robot lawn mower is on sale at Amazon for $664, down from the normal price of $999.99. That's a 34% discount that saves yard owners $335.99. The sale price matches the lowest we've spotted at Amazon.

Mashable Trend Report

You're in luck if you have a yard that measures about a quarter of an acre or you only want to mow that size per session. The EcoVacs Goat 01000 can handle mowing the lawn at a height between 1.2 and 3.2 inches. It can also navigate on hills that have a 45% slope. Plus, it has an IPX6 waterproof rating, so it'll be just fine sitting outside in the rain.

The EcoVacs Goat 01000 has a narrow body, making it possible to mow in spaces that are as tight as 2.3 feet wide. Its 3D obstacle avoidance technology works all day, even in dark conditions, making it no issue to send the mower out at dusk.

From the EcoVacs app, you'll be able to set the desired height, mowing areas, and mowing schedule. In addition to the convenience, EcoVacs mentions the Goat 01000 only reaches 57 decibels, compared to 65 to 100 from a standard push mower.

If you've been seeing robot lawn mowers in the neighborhood but decided they were too spendy, consider today's deal on the EcoVacs Goat 01000 robot lawn mower. The 34% discount at Amazon brings this model down to $664. Since this matches the lowest we've seen at Amazon, today is a great time to make the upgrade.

可混搭趋势报告

如果您有一个大约四分之一英亩的院子，或者您只想每次割草这个尺寸，那么您很幸运。 EcoVacs Goat 01000 可以修剪高度在 1.2 至 3.2 英寸之间的草坪。 它还可以在坡度为 45% 的山丘上导航。 另外，它具有 IPX6 防水等级，因此在雨中坐在户外也没有问题。

EcoVacs Goat 01000 机身较窄，可以在 2.3 英尺宽的狭小空间内进行割草。 其 3D 避障技术即使在黑暗条件下也能全天工作，因此黄昏时派割草机出去也不成问题。

通过 EcoVacs 应用程序，您将能够设置所需的高度、割草区域和割草时间表。 除了方便之外，EcoVacs 还提到，Goat 01000 的噪音仅为 57 分贝，而标准推式割草机的噪音为 65 至 100 分贝。

如果您在附近见过机器人割草机，但觉得它们太贵，请考虑今天的 EcoVacs Goat 01000 机器人割草机优惠。 亚马逊 34% 的折扣使该型号的价格降至 664 美元。 由于这与我们在亚马逊看到的最低水平相符，因此今天是进行升级的好时机。
